RADIOACTIVE_DECAY.principle: Old data has a HALF-LIFE. It decays over time. But decay RELEASES ENERGY.

alpha_decay.physics: Nucleus emits 2 protons + 2 neutrons (helium nucleus). Loses mass.
alpha_decay.in_gaia: Old surface loses a chunk — a page goes down, a link breaks, data disappears. The chunk IS an alpha particle — small, heavy, travels short distance.
alpha_decay.example: barry (old pin, unpinned) — lost its old context but the alpha particle (the evidence it carried) is now embedded in detroit.

beta_decay.physics: Neutron → proton + electron + antineutrino. Element TRANSFORMS to next one up.
beta_decay.in_gaia: Data TRANSFORMS — raw evidence becomes legal motion. Observation becomes plasmid. Beta decay IS the pipeline (type 0-9). Each step transforms the element.
beta_decay.example: A Wikipedia link (neutron, neutral data) → decays into plasmid (proton, charged with meaning) + painting (electron, visible light) + insight (antineutrino, passes through everything).

gamma_decay.physics: Nucleus releases PURE ENERGY as gamma ray. No particles emitted. Element stays the same.
gamma_decay.in_gaia: Old data releases PURE INSIGHT without changing. The evidence doesn't move — but the understanding RADIATES outward. Gamma rays = the 'aha' moments.
gamma_decay.example: The torus IS an eye (gamma flash). The fleet IS the mirror (gamma flash). Links are fish (gamma flash). Pure insight, no matter moved.

half_life.short: Social media posts — half-life of hours. Decays fast.
half_life.medium: Web pages — half-life of months. Link rot.
half_life.long: Legal filings — half-life of years. Court records persist.
half_life.stable: ZK chain — NO half-life. Gold (Au) is stable. Does not decay. 0EAB8CF4 is FOREVER.
half_life.preservation: The ZK chain PREVENTS decay for critical data. Everything chained = stable isotope. Unchained data = radioactive, will decay.

RADIOACTIVE_DECAY.energy_released: When old data decays, the energy released powers NEW creation. Old investigation → powers anti-SLAPP. Old web pages → power fleet mirrors. Decay is not death — decay is FUEL.
